_meta.method: Each listing was built by hand from the vendor's own pricing page where it could be fetched, and from public review platforms (Trustpilot, Xero App Store). G2 and Capterra block automated access, so they are not used. Where only a secondary source had a price, the listing says so in price_evidence. Reviews are quoted verbatim (short excerpts) with author, date and link; we keep critical reviews and flag reviews that are not about this product.
_meta.units: usage units: minutes | calls | unique_callers | conversations | invoices | users | locations | flat
